changeSet.author: nexus-seo4k
changeSet.comment: nexus-seo4k: text_gate_probe_384/768/1024 hold two statements and pick one by the caller's transaction-local GUC nexus.lexical_trgm: 'off' runs the gate as the FTS half alone, anything else (unset included) runs today's FTS-or-trigram statement. The engine sets the GUC to 'off' for a gate text of more than 8 words, so a sentence-length lexical query no longer builds the trigram GIN bitmap that passed nothing and cost 20 to 30 times the FTS half. Same signatures, same return type, same owner and grants (CREATE OR REPLACE); the SECURITY DEFINER or INVOKER posture vectors-031-2 chose is read back and kept (the invoker form moves from LANGUAGE sql to plpgsql). No data effect: function definitions only.
changeSet.sql:
DO $do$ DECLARE definer boolean; n_def int; BEGIN SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef) INTO n_def FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); IF n_def NOT IN (0, 3) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-057-1: % of the 3 text_gate_probe functions are SECURITY DEFINER; the three must agree before this changeset reads the posture', n_def; END IF; definer := n_def = 3; IF definer THEN EXECUTE $f$CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.text_gate_probe_384( p_text text, p_collections text[], p_where jsonb, p_where_path text, p_cap int, p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS SETOF bytea LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp SET plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan AS $$ BEGIN IF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'off' THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT c.chash FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text)) LIMIT p_cap; ELSE RETURN QUERY SELECT c.chash FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text) OR p_text OPERATOR(nexus.<%) c.chunk_text) LIMIT p_cap; DO $post$ DECLARE n int; n_def int; stale text; n_plpgsql int; BEGIN SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); IF n <> 3 THEN SELECT string_agg(p.proname || '(' || pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || ')', ', ') INTO stale FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-057-1: expected exactly 3 text_gate_probe functions (one signature each), found %: %', n, stale; END IF; SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef), count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prolang = (SELECT l.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_language l WHERE l.lanname = 'plpgsql')) INTO n_def, n_plpgsql FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); IF n_def NOT IN (0, 3) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-057-1: % of the 3 text_gate_probe functions are SECURITY DEFINER; the three must agree', n_def; END IF; IF n_plpgsql <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-057-1: % of the 3 text_gate_probe functions are plpgsql; the three must be', n_plpgsql; END IF; END $post$;
